content: Kaŋ nai uŋaniŋ Wapumdi yagamadi ginaŋ nabugoŋ mintamiŋa niŋguk, “Abalam du munta mu tibeŋ. Nu adi yahehewege, eŋ kibikoŋ wapum hinek mintagambune wohoge gigit loloŋnit hinek tibaak.”
Abalamdibo indiŋ yoguk, “Wapum Bepaŋ, du maŋgoŋ nambene nanilaŋ? Nu wapmihinenit mokit. Hogok itoulat doktiŋa Eliesa Damasiko yopmaniŋ adi nemenemek u kedem yabukahileeŋ moŋgolaak.”
Unduŋ yoŋa tomboyoula indiŋ yoguk. “Nadilaŋ be? Du wapmihi nemu namuŋguŋ doktiŋa biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, tipilapilayenedi nu’walaŋ kohone diki yabukahilewaak.”
Unduŋ yolune Wapum’walaŋ mede indiŋ mintamiŋguk, “Adi adi du’walaŋ kohoge diki mu yabukahilewaak. Mooŋ. Da’walaŋ mihige hinek mintawaakdi yabukahilewaak.”
Unduŋ yoŋa fakaŋ nagila fooŋ niŋguk. “Du dadiyeeŋ kunumneŋ dauge diweune loune hinantilamek yabeŋ. U kedem be kunaleŋ?” Tiŋa niŋguk, “Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, yalakigeye adi wondok tuwolit mintaulihakaneeŋ.”
Unduŋ yobune Abalamdi Wapum nadisukilitimiŋguk. Unduŋ tubune Bapaŋdi nadiune me didimeniŋ tuguk.
Tiŋa indiŋ niŋguk, “Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, Wapum Yaweh hatilat nuku kwet i gambene Ul yokwetneŋ Kaldea kwetneniŋ ganagila bugut.”
Ingoŋ oŋ Abalamdi yoguk, “O Wapum Yaweh, nu kwet i kahilewaat u mebi dediŋ foloŋ nadisukiliwit?”
Unduŋ yobune niŋguk, “Du wooŋ makau taamuniŋ niŋ guletŋiŋ 3 tuguk eŋ meme taamuniŋ eŋ dompa maaniŋ niŋ gulethik 3 tuguk eŋ bagi bitigilii eŋ bagi mihiniŋ nimaaŋ yabuŋa moŋgola buŋa nambeŋ.”
Abalamdi moŋgola buŋa lekiŋgoŋ hinek ulitawaaŋ faki fukufukuŋ habiye tauguk. Bagi hogok adigili mu ulitawaguk.
Kaŋ kalaŋkatak hekidi buŋa nemek munduŋnit u nanee tubune Abalamdi yahakali tuguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa mele fowe tulune Abalam adi domo kisaŋ nadiŋa dahatune mambip fuliŋgoŋdi kufulaune munta kisaŋ tuguk.

Unduŋ tulune Wapumdi Abalam indiŋ niŋguk, “Du indiŋ nadifafaŋeweŋ. Yalakigeye adi kwet niŋ aditok gigit mu yoŋit uŋaŋ hogok buŋambu wooŋ hatineeŋ. Tiŋa kwet molohiyedi yehididiŋene tubune tipilipilaye kwanai tiyem hatilune gulet 400 dapmawaak.
Eŋ tipilapilaye kwanai tiyemineeŋ mebop adi adi kibi nubo kibikoŋ wobuyembaat. Eŋ yalakigeye adi adi bomboŋ mohok hinit uneeŋ.
Da adi baha papageye adi’walaŋ hatikwele kwetneŋ fowaaŋ. Du hatihinakaaŋ gawada hinek tiŋa kumumbune gehiweneneeŋ.
Eŋ yalakigeye adi Amolihi metam’walaŋ kadakaniŋdi maniŋgoŋ mu tokilak dotiŋa uŋgoŋ hatitalolune ulihakahik nai 4 tubune udaneeŋ buneeŋ.”
Kaŋ mele foune bufa hinakalune mupmuk kulufe eŋ kamaŋ kudup mabemnit mintaaŋ kale faki fukufukuŋ hakiŋ lekiŋgoŋhik ginaŋ dapmaaŋ uguk.
Mele nai uŋaniŋ Yawehdi indiŋ yoŋa Abalamdut yofolok tugumuk.

content.text: “Isip kwet diniŋ imeneniŋ tububihila uge uge Yufeletis ime wapum ginaŋ dapmalak.
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, kwet u yalakigeye yemdok yokwambundalat.
